purpose: PQ3.3b OpenFOAM campaign that grows mean(rho_projection[active]) to the registered projected target through multi-iteration OC steps with a re-computed parent gradient per iteration.
supersedes_provisional_basis: raw design mean 0.02733 from checkpoint_chunk02 was previously used as V_target; the judged basis is now mean(rho_projection[active]) vs V_max in the projected basis.

input_checkpoint.sha256_sha_file: sha256 of the checkpoint file, recorded in docs/evidence/pq3_3b_preflight_v2_2026_09.json

fixed_configuration.target_comparison_basis: projected basis only; the raw design mean is never used as infeasibility evidence
fixed_configuration.parent_gradient_recompute: per iteration, via OpenFoamOracle.parent_evaluator, and pulled back to design space with transform.pullback_from_beta before the backend consumes it

levels.name: level_0_growth_b4_q15
levels.per_iteration_target_policy: reachable-frontier-cap: target_i = min(0.018, phi_upper(move box at iteration i)); a step whose frontier is below the current phi is a family failure, not a campaign failure; the level Exit is |phi - 0.018| <= tol or max_iterations exhausted (then No-Go for this level)

acceptance_gates: each level records preflight v2 numbers: masks_invariant true, phi monotone non-decreasing, frontier growth measured
final state: discreteness in rho_projection (mean_nd <= 0.01, max_rho >= 0.9) and the stage_s_entry composite ready_for_stage_s verdict must be recorded
no raw-design-mean.argument may be used to declare infeasibility
go_conditions_before_campaign: a backend kappa family that can raise phi above phi(design) in at least one registered level (measured with a fresh parent gradient per iteration)
preflight v2 re-run after the family decision: summary.all_levels_growth_possible == true
manifest immutability check via the sidecar sha256

measured_preflight_v2_result.interpretation: the registered multiplicative OC family (stepped = clip(values * max(-g,0)^eta * kappa, box)) cannot raise phi above phi(design): the gradient support is split nearly evenly (9420 receivers vs 9780 penalised, no zero cells) and receiver magnitudes are tiny (p50 ~ 9e-6), so no receiver crosses the tanh 0.5 threshold within the move box while the penalised half loses sub-threshold mass. Single-step AND multi-iteration growth to 0.018 is therefore not achievable with the current family; a campaign must NOT be started under the current backend.

backend_family_redesign_candidates.name: signed-translation family
backend_family_redesign_candidates.definition: stepped = clip(values + kappa * move * d, lower, upper) with per-cell d = sign(-pullback-downforce-gradient) combined with a projected-volume ascent direction; phi(kappa) is monotone per cell so bisection keeps its contract
backend_family_redesign_candidates.risk: two-direction family needs an explicit secondary bracket or per-cell velocity weighting to keep the single-kappa bisection meaningful

backend_family_redesign_candidates.name: volume-steered uniform-ascent family
backend_family_redesign_candidates.definition: stepped = clip(values + kappa * move * u, lower, upper) where u is the design-space pullback of the constant projected-volume ascent unit vector, restricted to the allowed cells; bisection on kappa keeps |phi - target| bound
backend_family_redesign_candidates.risk: ignores the downforce gradient during volume growth; the growth phase must be bounded and re-primed by a fresh parent gradient afterwards

next_step_owner: user decision on backend family (A or B) before scripts/pq3_3b_campaign_2026_09.py is written; the long OpenFOAM campaign is NOT started
